content:
h14.

**Computation site:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` for the persisted payload (tags + property), and `APIV1Service.getMemoContentSnippet()` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83` for the snippet. Both delegate to `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go`) — `ExtractAll()` (line 356) for the payload, and `GenerateSnippet()` (line 264) for the snippet.

**Triggers (three operations):**

1. **`CreateMemo`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` before persisting.
2. **`UpdateMemo`** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` when the `content` field is in the update mask.
3. **`Runner.RunOnce`** — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` bulk-rebuilds every memo's payload (batch migration/repair job).
4. The **snippet** is computed on-the-fly at read time (not persisted) — every API response conversion path calls `getMemoContentSnippet` (e.g., `memo_service_converter.go:76`, `memo_relation_service.go:154`, `user_service_notifications.go:323`).

**Extracted properties** (defined in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:272–278`, computed via goldmark AST walk in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`):

| Property | What it detects |
|---|---|
| `has_link` (bool) | Content contains a markdown link (`KindLink`) |
| `has_task_list` (bool) | Content contains GFM task checkboxes (`KindTaskCheckBox`) |
| `has_code` (bool) | Content contains code blocks or inline code spans |
| `has_incomplete_tasks` (bool) | At least one unchecked task checkbox |
| `title` (string) | Plain text of the first block-level H1 heading, if present |
| `tags` (string[]) | All `#tag` nodes (deduplicated, set on `Payload.Tags` at `runner.go:85`) |
| `snippet` (string, output-only, not persisted) | Plain-text summary ≤ 64 chars, stripping code blocks, truncated at word boundary |
